Hi Rodrigo,

Not sure why data() doesn't work: looks like it's calling a getDatasets() function in the java code, can you file an issue?

In the meantime, you can find the datasets packaged with Renjin (copied from R 2.14.2) in the src/main/data directory of each package:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/tree/master/packages/datasets/src/main/data

Best,
Alex
